blocked-threads:caller.title: Decision service runs out of threads
blocked-threads:caller.message: It holds a thread for 260 ms per request (250 ms waiting on Partner scoring API). At 400 req/s it needs 104 threads; it has 64 (4 replicas × 16).
blocked-threads:caller.rationale: Waiting calls occupy threads without using CPU. A fix is offered only after a same-seed rerun confirms it.
blocked-threads:caller.shownRationale: Waiting calls retain resources. A timeout bounds waiting; it does not cancel downstream work.

scaling-blind:caller.title: Decision service scales on CPU, but its threads wait
scaling-blind:caller.message: At full load it uses 31% CPU against a 70% target while the backlog grows. A same-seed rerun confirmed scaling on busy threads.
scaling-blind:caller.rationale: Busy threads counts working threads and threads waiting on calls; CPU only sees work.
scaling-blind:caller.shownRationale: Waiting calls retain resources. A timeout bounds waiting; it does not cancel downstream work.

call-timeout:call.title: No timeout on the call to Partner scoring API
call-timeout:call.message: If it stalls, every thread waits.
call-timeout:call.rationale: A timeout bounds waiting; downstream work can still finish and reply late.
call-timeout:call.shownRationale: Waiting calls retain resources. A timeout bounds waiting; it does not cancel downstream work.
